sql:
WITH actual AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
quota AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmountQuota) AS quota_amount
    FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY StoreKey
),
attainment AS (
    SELECT
        a.StoreKey,
        st.StoreName,
        a.actual_sales,
        q.quota_amount,
        a.actual_sales / nullif(q.quota_amount, 0) AS quota_attainment
    FROM actual a
    JOIN quota q ON a.StoreKey = q.StoreKey
    JOIN retail.DimStore st ON a.StoreKey = st.StoreKey
)
SELECT StoreKey, StoreName, actual_sales, quota_amount, quota_attainment, 'Top 5' AS segment
FROM attainment
ORDER BY quota_attainment DESC
LIMIT 5
UNION ALL
SELECT StoreKey, StoreName, actual_sales, quota_amount, quota_attainment, 'Bottom 5' AS segment
FROM attainment
ORDER BY quota_attainment ASC
LIMIT 5
